title: The Testimony Of The Seas And Rivers 4th Degree Conclusion And Text Of Testimony

questions.question: What small part of the truths in the seas and rivers did the traveler understand?
questions.answer: He understood only a very tiny part of what they show.

questions.question: What message do the seas give with one united voice?
questions.answer: They point to Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: How strong is the witness of the seas described to be?
questions.answer: It is described as strong in a way that matches their huge size.

questions.question: Who are brought forward as witnesses from the seas?
questions.answer: The living things inside them are brought as witnesses.

questions.question: What two kinds of water places are included in the testimony in this passage?
questions.answer: The seas and the rivers are included.

questions.question: What does the passage say all the seas and rivers together show about Allah?
questions.answer: They show that Allah truly exists and is One.

questions.question: Name one sign in the waters that supports this testimony.
questions.answer: Their being controlled and managed in an orderly way is one sign.

questions.question: Name another sign in the waters that supports this testimony.
questions.answer: The creatures in them being kept safe is another sign.

questions.question: What does “storing up” tell us about the seas and rivers?
questions.answer: It tells us that what is in them is kept and provided in a planned way.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention that these signs can be observed?
questions.answer: It shows that people can notice these proofs by looking carefully at the world.

questions.question: After looking at the oceans and rivers, what did the traveler realize about their proofs?
questions.answer: He realized they contain many truths and declarations about Allah.

questions.question: Did the traveler see all of those truths or only a little of them?
questions.answer: He saw only a little of them.

questions.question: In the passage, how do the seas speak if they do not use human words?
questions.answer: They speak through the signs found in them.

questions.question: What is the main belief that the seas announce?
questions.answer: They announce that only Allah is worthy of worship.

questions.question: Besides the seas, what other waters give the same testimony?
questions.answer: The rivers give the same testimony.

questions.question: What do all the creatures in the waters do in this description?
questions.answer: They serve as witnesses supporting that testimony.

questions.question: Which qualities of the waters are pointed out as signs of Allah’s existence: confusion or order?
questions.answer: Order is pointed out as a sign.

questions.question: What does the passage teach by mentioning preservation in the waters?
questions.answer: It teaches that what is in the waters is protected by Allah’s care.

questions.question: What does wide and regular administration mean here?
questions.answer: It means the waters and what is in them are managed in a large, organized way.

questions.question: What did the traveler notice about the truths found in the seas and rivers?
questions.answer: He noticed that they hold far more truths than he could fully grasp.

questions.question: How do the seas give their testimony: separately or together?
questions.answer: They give it together, in agreement.

questions.question: What exact belief is supported by the testimony of the waters?
questions.answer: It supports belief in Allah alone.

questions.question: Who inside the waters supports this testimony?
questions.answer: All the creatures living in them support it.

questions.question: Why does the passage connect the strength of the testimony to the size of the seas?
questions.answer: It shows that their witness is huge and powerful, just like their vastness.

questions.question: What are four signs named in the passage that point to Allah through the seas and rivers?
questions.answer: Their being under control, being protected, having things stored in them, and being managed in an orderly way.

questions.question: Does the passage present these signs as hidden ideas only, or as things people can notice?
questions.answer: It presents them as things people can notice.

questions.question: What did the traveler perceive from the oceans and rivers?
questions.answer: He perceived that they give testimony about Allah.

questions.question: How much of their full meaning did he perceive?
questions.answer: He perceived only a tiny portion of it.

questions.question: What do the seas say with one shared message?
questions.answer: They say that there is no true god but Allah.

questions.question: What shows that this message is not from one sea alone?
questions.answer: The passage says the seas proclaim it unanimously, meaning all together.

questions.question: What role do the creatures in the waters have in the passage?
questions.answer: They act as witnesses that support the message.

questions.question: What two groups of waters are spoken of together in the formal statement?
questions.answer: Seas and rivers are spoken of together.

questions.question: Which is a better summary of the waters in this passage: random and neglected, or controlled and ordered?
questions.answer: Controlled and ordered.

questions.question: What does preservation tell us about life and things in the waters?
questions.answer: It tells us they are being guarded and maintained.

questions.question: What does regular administration tell us about how the waters work?
questions.answer: It tells us they operate according to an organized plan.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the whole passage?
questions.answer: The main idea is that seas, rivers, and the creatures in them point to Allah’s necessary existence and oneness.

questions.question: When the traveler looked at the seas and rivers, what kind of evidence did he find?
questions.answer: He found signs that affirm belief in Allah.

questions.question: Was his understanding complete or limited?
questions.answer: His understanding was limited.

questions.question: What central truth do the seas declare?
questions.answer: They declare Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: How do we know the testimony of the seas is very strong?
questions.answer: The passage says its strength matches their great size.

questions.question: What from inside the seas is used like proof or witnesses?
questions.answer: The creatures living in them are used as proof.

questions.question: What shared testimony do both seas and rivers give?
questions.answer: They both point to Allah’s true existence and unity.

questions.question: What does subjugation mean in this passage in a simple way?
questions.answer: It means the waters are under Allah’s control.

questions.question: How does the idea of storing things in the waters add to the proof?
questions.answer: It shows that what is in them is kept by careful planning, not by accident.

questions.question: What did the traveler learn from the oceans and rivers in this passage?
questions.answer: He learned that they carry many signs pointing to Allah.

questions.question: Did he grasp all those signs or just a small amount?
questions.answer: He grasped just a small amount.

questions.question: What unified statement do the seas make?
questions.answer: They make the statement that Allah alone is the true God.

questions.question: How are the seas described as making this statement?
questions.answer: They make it together and with great strength.

questions.question: Who testifies along with the seas and rivers?
questions.answer: Everything living in them testifies along with them.

questions.question: According to the passage, what do all seas and rivers point to about Allah?
questions.answer: They point to His necessary existence and His unity.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the management of the waters?
questions.answer: It says they are managed in a broad and orderly way.

questions.question: What does the mention of protection and storage suggest about the water world?
questions.answer: It suggests that the water world is cared for and maintained with wisdom.

questions.question: Why is this passage good for reflection?
questions.answer: It helps us notice that even the seas and rivers teach us about Allah.
